title: Russian drones strike Kyiv’s Southern Bridge three times in several hours. Traffic restrictions spread to two other Dnipro crossings. — Meduza
text:
Stated Claim / Post Context:
Russian drones strike Kyiv’s Southern Bridge three times in several hours. Traffic restrictions spread to two other Dnipro crossings. — Meduza

Russian forces continued their drone attacks on Kyiv. One of the targets was the Southern Bridge across the Dnipro River, which drones attacked three times over several hours, Ukrainska Pravda reported.

Actual Article Body:
Russian forces continued their drone attacks on Kyiv. One of the targets was the Southern Bridge across the Dnipro River, which drones attacked three times over several hours, Ukrainska Pravda reported.

The Southern Bridge is closed to traffic. Traffic is restricted on two other bridges across the Dnipro: the Paton Bridge and the Metro Bridge. Public transit routes have been changed because of the bridge closures. UNIAN reported “transportation chaos in Kyiv.”

A Russian drone strike also damaged a 25-story apartment building in Kyiv’s Darnytskyi district. Ukraine’s State Emergency Service said one person was killed and at least two others were injured.
